name: cvolo-language
description: Cvolo language support for Visual Studio Code via the standalone Cvolo Language Server.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Cvolo Language Server requires filesystem-backed source files; a .cvlproj is optional.

cvolo.server.path.description: Development/advanced-user override for the Cvolo Language Server executable. Empty uses a bundled server when present, then cvolo-language-server from PATH.

cvolo.libraryPaths.description: Additional .cvlib files, or directories whose top-level .cvlib files are mounted, for loose Cvolo workspaces only. Relative paths are resolved against the loose workspace semantic root. This setting is ignored for manifest-backed .cvlproj projects.

cvolo.trace.server.description: Trace communication between VS Code and the Cvolo Language Server.

cvolo.codeLens.references.description: Show a CodeLens with the number of references to each declaration. Clicking it opens the normal references view.

cvolo.codeLens.layout.description: Show a CodeLens with the compiler-computed size, alignment and padding of each concrete type. Clicking it opens the detailed type layout.

cvolo.codeLens.fields.description: Master switch for the CodeLens row on every field. Turns both per-field lenses off without changing the type-level lenses.

cvolo.codeLens.fieldReferences.description: Show a CodeLens with the number of references to each field. Only used when "cvolo.codeLens.fields" is enabled.

cvolo.codeLens.fieldLayout.description: Show a CodeLens with the offset, size, alignment and preceding padding of each field. Only used when "cvolo.codeLens.fields" is enabled.

cvolo.codeLens.nativeInterop.description: Show CodeLens for native import/export declarations that carry Cvolo Compiler ABI information.

cvolo.inlayHints.types.description: Show inferred type hints for declarations that have no explicit type.

cvolo.inlayHints.parameters.description: Show parameter name hints at call sites.

cvolo.inlayHints.receiverMutability.description: Show receiver mutability hints for methods that borrow or mutate their receiver.

cvolo.inlayHints.layout.description: Show field layout hints such as offset and size inside type bodies.

cvolo.inlayHints.enumValues.description: Show the compiler-assigned numeric value of enum variants.

cvolo.inlayHints.genericArguments.description: Show inferred generic arguments at call and construction sites.

cvolo.layout.offsetFormat.description: Notation used for byte counts in field layout decorations.

cvolo.layout.showPaddingPercentage.description: Show padding in the type layout view as a byte count followed by the share of the type it takes.

cvolo.layout.autoRefresh.description: Keep the type layout view up to date while you edit the source of the type it shows.
